capacity_evidence: Aligned or PCA teacher supervision improves training-mode recall versus initialization and reference-only control with positive paired95% family lower bound; mean gain at least0.10 versus reference, valid fraction no more than0.01 below initialization. Report strict-threshold sensitivity and all settings. This is evidence to test generalization, not promotion.
frame_evidence: Matched aligned-versus-PCA comparison with identical labels, seeds and budgets. Report intervals; no causal conclusion from aligned-versus-reference alone.
if_capacity_learned: Evaluate held-out development/native tuning before broader training. A successful small-panel fit is not expected to improve generalization directly. Carry successful recipe to broader frozen training data only with matched control and reconstruction checks.
if_capacity_not_learned: Inspect loss, actual flow time/noise schedule, conditioning and latent-mode recall before decoded validity. Test targeted intervention or longer optimization only if measurements identify a plausible cause; stop repeated blind sweeps.
if_geometry_is_limiting: Separate teacher roundtrip, predicted-latent geometry and mode assignment. Test a small decoded-geometry correction/loss against a matched control, with structural-displacement accounting and no native-assisted inference.
